pkgmetadata.longdescription: FastFlowLM (FLM) is a lightweight LLM inference runtime purpose-built for AMD Ryzen AI NPUs (XDNA2 architecture). It provides an Ollama-style CLI and an OpenAI-compatible server API for running language models entirely on the NPU. Supported hardware: Ryzen AI 300-series (Strix Point, Strix Halo), 400-series (Gorgon Point) and Z2 Extreme. XDNA1 (Ryzen AI 7000/8000) is not supported. The CLI is MIT licensed; the NPU compute kernels are proprietary binaries.
